name: install_generated_plugin
description: Register, install, and start a plugin generate_plugin_scaffold has already written to disk -- reads its server_entry.json, registers it with the hub's local plugin store, installs it, and starts it. Each stage (register/install/start) that fails is reported distinctly via a 'stage' field, with no partial success reported as full success; re-call this alone (no need to regenerate) if only a later stage failed. Once registered, this plugin's host-assigned nsid is persisted back into its own server_entry.json; every later call for the same location checks whether that nsid is still registered or still installed on the host BEFORE acting, and refuses with a 'conflict: true' response (naming what it found) instead of silently re-registering or re-installing -- resolve a reported conflict with update_registered_plugin (refresh the registration in place; also syncs to the installed record automatically if installed), delete_registered_plugin and/or uninstall_installed_plugin (a harder reset), or do nothing to abort. Always confirm with the customer before calling this -- it makes real changes on the hub, unlike generate_plugin_scaffold which only writes local files.

location.description: The 'location' a generate_plugin_scaffold/list_generated_plugins call returned, identifying which generated plugin to install.
